name: Australian English
notes: Australian English. Non-rhotic. FACE raising: /eɪ/ → [æɪ] (the 'Strine' stereotype). PRICE = [ɑɪ]; FLEECE = [ɪi] (diphthongal). Three sociolects: Broad (most Australian), General, Cultivated. Source: Wells (1982) vol. 3.
